description: This Java class, TableGenerator, reads CSV data via XYDataReader and generates a C header file with a multi-dimensional float array based on the data, likely for use in embedded or firmware code.

classes.name: TableGenerator
classes.description: A utility class to convert XY data from CSV into a C array initialization code file, facilitating data transfer from Java to embedded C code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that reads XY data from a CSV file and initiates writing the C array.

methods.name: writeAsC
methods.description: Public method to generate C code from XY data, wrapping doWrite with exception handling.

methods.name: doWrite
methods.description: Generates a multi-dimensional C float array based on XY data, formatting it as a C initializer.

methods.name: writeArray
methods.description: Helper to output RPM-related data as a #define count and float array.

methods.name: outputDoubles
methods.description: Outputs a list of doubles as a static float array in C syntax.
